mapper.sql: r.id AS `cursor`, r.receipt_no AS receiptNo, p.payment_no AS paymentNo, o.order_no AS orderNo, a.merchant_request_no AS attemptNo, r.channel_code AS channelCode, r.amount AS amount, r.currency AS currency, r.disposition AS disposition, r.provider_paid_at AS providerPaidAt, r.confirmed_at AS confirmedAt, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.refunded_amount AS refundedAmount, r.refund_reserved_amount AS refundReservedAmount, (r.amount-r.refunded_amount-r.refund_reserved_amount) AS unreservedAmount, r.version AS version

FROM tc_payment_receipt r JOIN tc_payment_intent p ON p.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND p.id=r.intent_id JOIN tc_order o ON o.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND o.id=r.order_id JOIN tc_payment_attempt a ON a.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND a.id=r.attempt_id AND a.intent_id=r.intent_id
